scope: Connects the existing odd-log FFT adapter to the host/CUDA microbenchmark harness without changing CUDA arithmetic. Eight tiny host DFT checks cover square/odd log2_m 1..4; simulated CUDA reports check mode, input, allocation, merge, twiddle work and finite timings. Host CLI routing and append-only distinct result names are checked. No CUDA launch or new static CUDA build; earlier compilation evidence remains separately linked.
